review_candidates.title: Azure Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: This role will design, administer, secure, monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve cloud infrastructure while establishing operational standards and mentoring other IT team members. What You’ll Do Design, implement, administer, and optimize secure, scalable, and highly available Azure infrastructure aligned with business, security, and compliance requirements. Administer Azure-hosted Windows Server environments, including deployment, configuration, patching, performance tuning, capacity
eligibility_evidence: Experience with Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Policy, Azure Update Manager, Microsoft Intune, and hybrid identity or connectivity.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Bennett Thrasher is seeking an Azure Infrastructure Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership for our Azure server environment and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) platform. What You’ll Do Design, implement, administer, and optimize secure, scalable, and highly available Azure infrastructure aligned with business, security, and compliance requirements. What You Bring 6+ years of progressive infrastructure engineering or systems administration experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on Microsoft Azure engineering in production environments. Hands-on administration of Azure Virtual Desktop and Nerdio Manager for Enterprise, including image management, autoscaling, host pool configuration, FSLogix, application delivery, monitoring, and troubleshooting. Proficiency with PowerShell and working knowledge of Azure CLI, ARM templates, Bicep, Terraform, or another infrastructure-as-cod
